title: Oracle: a common user without SET CONTAINER and CONTAINER_DATA=ALL sees MISSING_TABLE_IN_SOURCE

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: Oracle Free 23.26.3, common user, standard gateway, one run

symptom: The gateway found 0 tables and reported MISSING_TABLE_IN_SOURCE: "No catalog or schema was found for replication. Please check your filter file". The message names no privilege.
cause: Not established why the check reports a missing table. The two grants let the common user see the PDB's tables.
effect: The pipeline looks misconfigured in its filter.
fix: Grant SET CONTAINER and ALTER USER ... SET CONTAINER_DATA=ALL CONTAINER=CURRENT (in the grant list), then restart the pipelines.
notes: One run. The re-run after the grants found the tables.
